high.title: Banks Unexpectedly Use Stock Dividends to "Keep Money"
high.summary: Vietnamese banks are increasingly using stock dividends instead of cash to preserve capital for growth. TPBank approved a total dividend rate of 20%, with only 5% in cash and 15% in stock, raising charter capital by up to 4.161 trillion VND. MSB similarly approved 20% stock dividends from owner equity. This trend reflects banks' priority to strengthen capital foundations for future growth amid tight credit room allocations. The strategy helps banks retain cash while still rewarding shareholders, particularly important as banks face regulatory capital requirements and limited credit growth quotas from the State Bank of Vietnam.

high.title: Q1/2026 Banking Results Update: Emerging Bank Reports 268% Profit Growth
high.summary: ABBank recorded the highest profit growth at 268% in Q1/2026, with pre-tax profit reaching 1.5 trillion VND. BIDV reported 8.571 trillion VND in pre-tax profit, up 16% YoY. Total assets grew 1.7% to 3.388 million trillion VND, while customer loans increased 2.4% to over 2.4 million trillion VND. However, customer deposits fell 3.6% to 2.14 million trillion VND, while certificate of deposit issuance surged 48.6% to over 228 trillion VND. This shift indicates banks are paying higher costs for funding as they compete for deposits in a tight liquidity environment, which could pressure net interest margins going forward.

high.title: Q1/2026 Financial Results Update April 28: 16 Companies Report Trillion VND Profits, Banking Dominates
high.summary: 16 companies reported trillion-VND profits in Q1/2026, with banking sector dominating with 7 representatives, led by Techcombank (8.87 trillion VND) and BIDV (8.572 trillion VND). Banking sector maintained steady growth of 16-58%, with VPBank and Techcombank showing strong performance while LPBank and Saigonbank recorded negative growth. Securities firms like SSI, VPS, and TCBS all reported trillion-VND profits with double-digit growth, but smaller firms struggled with significant losses. This polarization suggests market consolidation and the advantage of scale in the current operating environment, particularly important for FX and bond market liquidity.

medium.title: Dividend Ex-Rights Schedule Week 27/4-1/5: Highest Cash Dividend 90%, One Bank Pays Over 3,000 Billion VND
medium.summary: VIB will go ex-dividend on April 29 for 2025 cash dividend at 9% rate, paying approximately 3.063.6 trillion VND to shareholders. This represents significant cash outflow from the banking system that could affect liquidity conditions.

medium.title: Gold Ring and Bar Prices April 27
medium.summary: International gold prices dropped 0.25% to $4,696/ounce amid stronger USD and rising oil prices raising inflation concerns. Gold fell over 2.5% last week due to expectations of prolonged high interest rates as US-Iran peace negotiations remain stalled, affecting safe-haven demand.

medium.title: State Bank of Vietnam Issues Important Warning Regarding Biometric Data
medium.summary: The State Bank of Vietnam requires credit institutions to strengthen cybersecurity as criminals collect biometric data to open fake bank accounts for fraud and money laundering. Banks must upgrade technology infrastructure with AI/deepfake detection solutions for Mobile and Online Banking authentication.

medium.title: Expert: Don't Look at Indices to Buy, These Are 4 Stock Groups That Could "Follow" Vingroup's Wave
medium.summary: VN-Index remains high due to large-cap leadership, particularly Vingroup, while money flow hasn't spread evenly across the market. Analysts warn of short-term volatility risks despite limited deep correction probability, suggesting market consolidation around major stocks.

medium.title: Several Banks to Be Established Soon
medium.summary: Vietcombank approved establishing a 100%-owned subsidiary bank at Vietnam's International Financial Center (IFC) with 3 trillion VND charter capital, focusing on specialized financial services for IFC members rather than traditional commercial banking.
